title: Moon Landing
description: Apollo 11 landed on the Moon on July 20, 1969. Neil Armstrong became the first human to walk on the lunar surface.

title: Fall of the Berlin Wall
description: The Berlin Wall fell on November 9, 1989, marking the end of the Cold War division of Germany.

title: End of World War II
description: World War II ended on September 2, 1945 with Japan's formal surrender aboard the USS Missouri.

title: COVID-19 Pandemic Declaration
description: The World Health Organization declared COVID-19 a global pandemic on March 11, 2020.

title: 9/11 Attacks
description: On September 11, 2001, coordinated terrorist attacks struck New York City, Washington D.C., and Pennsylvania.

title: First iPhone Release
description: Apple released the first iPhone on June 29, 2007, revolutionizing the smartphone industry.

title: Apollo 11 Launch
description: Apollo 11 launched from Kennedy Space Center on July 16, 1969, beginning the historic journey to the Moon.

title: Titanic Sinking
description: The RMS Titanic sank on April 15, 1912 after striking an iceberg, claiming over 1,500 lives.
